long_description:
Join us for our first annual Celebration of Hope & Healing, a Ladies' Night Out dance party benefiting Lotus of Hope Yoga!

Get ready for a night of dancing featuring @djlunarriot, sparkle from @electricglowclub, delicious drinks, tasty appetizers, exciting raffle prizes, and a whole lot of fun at @hiddengemstl

Every ticket purchased helps Lotus of Hope Yoga partner with local shelters and crisis intervention organizations to bring free, trauma-informed yoga directly to survivors in St. Louis.

We can't wait to celebrate with you!

#CelebrationOfHopeAndHealing #LotusOfHopeYoga #LadiesNightOut #StLouisEvents #Fundraiser #SupportSurvivors
